Messages.Body:
Can you play cards or effects that are directed on other vampires on
vampires you control ?

Orpheus

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Orpheus wrote:
>
> Can you play cards or effects that are directed on other vampires on
> vampires you control ?

Actions are directed only if they target another Methuselah's stuff.

If the action targets a vampire you control, then it isn't directed.
